## Change
Describe the behavior and link its requirement section. For a design change, link the design decision.

<a id="verifiering"></a>
## Verification
State the test environment and observed result. Distinguish emulator tests from physical tests and report remaining checks.

## Requirements and test review
Record the separate requirements analyst and tester subagents' outcomes and reviewed commits, requirement and acceptance coverage, and the developer's resolution of findings. For UX-impacting changes, include the UX designer's assessment and the applicable design decision. Link required check results for the current revision and identify outstanding decisions or acceptance conditions. Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md#work-tracking-and-status) before merge.
